definition: Impossible to explain or understand from the available facts.
author: Jane Austen
quote: A very few days brought the party from London, and she had no sooner an opportunity of being one hour alone with Harriet, than she became perfectly satisfied—unaccountable as it was!
example_sentence: For some unaccountable reason, the dishwasher only works on Tuesdays.
